About Umair

A developer shaped by curiosity and craft.

I care about the full experience — how a page communicates, how it behaves, how fast it responds, and how confidently it represents the business behind it.

The short versionFrontend developer in Mumbai with documented experience across responsive websites, landing pages, WordPress, ecommerce tooling, performance, and SEO-minded implementation.
My story

From map detail
to interface detail.

View experience

My path has consistently rewarded precision: first while contributing detailed navigation data at HERE Maps, and later while designing and developing web experiences at Nexgeno Technology.

Since January 2023, my current resume records full-stack delivery across responsive websites, CMS applications, PHP frameworks, databases, REST APIs, integrations, testing, debugging, and deployment.

That work spans WordPress themes and plugins, GSAP-driven experiences, HRMS and RBAC workflows, Laravel CRM and property systems, attendance APIs, Shipway, cron automation, and Stripe, Razorpay, and PayU payment flows with webhooks.

A B.Sc. in Information Technology from Mumbai University supports the foundation, while day-to-day optimization covers query performance, minification, lazy loading, image compression, WebP, PageSpeed Insights, GTmetrix, and SEO.
